name: scroll-velocity-marquee
title: Scroll Velocity Marquee
description: A marquee that crawls on its own and speeds up or reverses with how fast the page scrolls. Pauses off screen and stays still under reduced motion.

props.name: speed
props.description: Resting speed in percent of the content width per second.

props.name: scrollBoost
props.description: How much scroll speed adds to the marquee. 0 ignores the scroll.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to listen to. Defaults to the page.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
